objective: Compare target engagement among clinically characterized agents and explicit mechanistic/clinical comparators; no inference that stronger dual inhibition protects the liver.
primary_boltz_metric: binding_confidence within each target for binder identification
filters: server defaults, exclusions retained with reasons
direction: inhibition comparator screen; a binding pose does not identify activation versus inhibition
clinical_interpretation: Human authorization/indication, experimental wild-type target pharmacology and labeled hepatic liabilities considered separately from predictions.
docking: Independent structure-based docking with ligand-redocking calibration for PDGFRA; FLT4 predicted kinase scaffold labeled explicitly if no experimental kinase complex is available.
md: Genuine trajectories required for dynamics; no relaxation or conformer ensemble interpreted as production MD.
selection: No compound promoted as hepatoprotective solely from affinity, docking score or physicochemical prediction.
